verified_signals.signal: PrivatBank's re-launched recycling-ATM purchase is live on the bank's own e-procurement platform: 'Ресайклінговий банкомат (1 етап)' PB-2026-03-17-3068329, single lot, CPV DK 021:2015 30123200-9 (ATMs), ref. 445/3930 of 17/03/2026. QUANTITY (missed by the first pass, now sourced from the tender's own Request for Qualification Documents): 700 lobby-type recyclers PLUS 300 through-the-wall recyclers = 1,000 machines, each 'including a 2-year warranty service (provision of spare parts)'. Two-stage design: stage 1 is qualification only — bidders submit compliance documents WITHOUT PRICES and must hand over physical test samples for the bank to trial against its software, OS, monitoring and cash-in-transit control systems; qualifiers pass to stage 2, an electronic reverse auction on price ('the bidding date will be determined based on the qualification results'). Timetable: clarifications 17/03/2026-02/04/2026, bids 02/04-08/04/2026, prequalification open from 08/04/2026; spec amended 30/03/2026 (English version issued 23/03/2026, amendments touched camera resolution and through-the-wall service clearances). Budget NOT disclosed ('не вказано') and NO donor/grant funding is stated anywhere in the notice or in either the Ukrainian or English spec. Status as of 31/07/2026: still 'Прекваліфікація' (prequalification), no award, no stage 2 published. Spec locks in incumbent-shaped requirements: integration with the bank's existing Diebold Nixdorf 'Vynamic View' monitoring (Vynamic View is DN's ATM estate-monitoring software), Windows 11 64-bit LTSC, CEN/XFS 3.50 (the banking standard that lets one application drive any vendor's ATM hardware), compatibility no lower than ProFlex 4.x / VCP Pro 7 across all modules, Worldline processing protocols, at least 4 recycling denominations, twin cassette sets reconfigurable recycler/deposit/cashout, 2,000-note cassettes. Commercial gates: 3% performance bank guarantee, and exclusion of bidders with Russian/Belarusian ('unacceptably high-risk country') ties. Pricing benchmark from the bank's own prior round: the completed 2024 stage-2 'Ресайклінгові банкомати (2 етап)' PB-2024-05-20-3055047 carried an announced budget of EUR 18,678,948.30 and priced the 2-year-warranty variant at EUR 37,300 per unit ex-VAT.

verified_signals.signal: PrivatBank has now FAILED TWICE to award maintenance of its Diebold Nixdorf recycler estate, and has stated on the record that it intends to re-run to widen the bidder field. Attempt 1: 'Послуги з обслуговування ресайклінгових банкоматів Diebold Nixdorf' PB-2025-10-21-3065668, UAH 4,080,000 incl. VAT, published 21/10/2025, bids closed 06/11/2025 — attracted ZERO bidders ('Учасники вiдсутнi'), status 'Закупівля не відбулась' (procurement did not take place), despite 9 clarification questions. Attempt 2: PB-2026-03-25-3068553, same budget UAH 4,080,000.00 incl. VAT (ref. 445/3979 of 25/03/2026, amended 02/04/2026), an e-auction structured as a reverse auction on a total indicative tariff with a notional lot value of UAH 6,980.00 incl. VAT as the bid basis and a 1% minimum decrement — attracted exactly 1 participant (identity withheld: 'Інформація про учасників не розкривається') and was cancelled by the tender committee, notice dated 01/05/2026, expressly 'by decision of the Tender Committee in order to re-run the procedure, including for the purpose of attracting a larger number of participants or for the purpose of applying a negotiated procedure, where grounds exist.' Scope is SLM (Second Line Maintenance — the deeper repair tier behind first-line/on-site fixes) of DN recyclers to current PCI DSS, PCI PTS and EMV Co standards, call handling 09:00-18:00 Mon-Fri via an email-based ticket system, framework contract of 1 year, volumes 'provided as needed' with the bank reserving +/-20% volume flex; the number of DN machines covered is NOT disclosed. As of 31/07/2026 no third attempt has been published. Separately, the estate is multi-OEM: PrivatBank has also tendered maintenance of GRG Banking H68NL recyclers (PB-2023-10-04-3049481, UAH 900,000, completed; an earlier attempt PB-2021-11-08-3037388, UAH 700,000, was cancelled).
verified_signals.source_name: tender.privatbank.ua — tender notices PB-2026-03-25-3068553 and PB-2025-10-21-3065668, plus the amended Tender Documentation of 02/04/2026
verified_signals.implies: A genuinely unserved service need with a written invitation to new entrants. Two failed procurements at an identical UAH 4.08m budget — one with no bidders at all, one with a single bidder — plus an explicit tender-committee statement that it will re-run to attract more participants OR go to a negotiated procedure. A negotiated procedure is the one route where a credible unsolicited approach can convert without an auction. It also confirms Diebold Nixdorf recyclers sit in the estate alongside GRG Banking units, so multi-vendor service capability is a differentiator here, and it flags that the bank's own budget for DN recycler SLM may be priced below what the market will accept.
verified_signals.likelihood: High for a re-run or a negotiated approach — the bank has published its intent to do exactly that; timing is unstated and nothing has appeared in three months.
verified_signals.win: Accessibility hint: HIGH. Zero bidders once and one bidder once means near-no competitive incumbency to displace, and the committee has invited a wider field in writing. NOT a forecast of outcome.
verified_signals.followup: 1) Contact Svitlana Hlotova (svitlana.hlotova@privatbank.ua, +380503187367) directly about the re-run and specifically about the negotiated-procedure option the committee flagged. 2) Establish the installed DN recycler count — it is withheld in both notices and is the missing number needed to judge whether UAH 4.08m is realistic. 3) Test whether the twice-failed pricing is the reason for failure. 4) Treat this as the low-cost route into the account that de-risks the far larger signal-1 hardware tender.

verified_signals.signal: [NEW — found during verification, freshest item in the unit] PrivatBank is buying an independent technical-condition assessment across roughly 1,000 self-service machines, in parallel with its 1,000-unit recycler purchase. Tender PB-2026-06-24-3070661 'Експертне заключення щодо технічного стану банкоматів і терміналів самообслуговування' (expert opinion on the technical condition of ATMs and self-service terminals), UAH 200,000.00 incl. VAT, simplified procedure, single lot, CPV DK 021:2015 71319000-7 (expert services), ref. 445/4416 of 24/06/2026. The technical annex orders two deliverables: 700 units of 'equipment technical-condition acts' and 300 units of 'defect statements assessing the value of damage to equipment damaged as a result of acts of vandalism' — 1,000 assessments in total over a 1-year framework contract. Delivery is desk-based: the bank sends device type, inventory number, serial number, installation address and a list of broken parts, and the supplier returns the condition act or defect statement within 3 calendar days WITHOUT visiting the machine. Published 24/06/2026, bids closed 01/07/2026 18:00, qualification 01/07-14/07/2026, 1 participant, status 'Пропозиції розглянуто' (proposals reviewed).
verified_signals.source_name: tender.privatbank.ua — tender notice PB-2026-06-24-3070661 and its Request for Price Quotations, Annex 1 Technical Specification
verified_signals.implies: This is a hard leading indicator that the recycler refresh in signal 1 is real and sized, not aspirational. A bank does not commission 700 formal condition acts plus 300 vandalism damage valuations unless it is building the write-off and insurance/war-damage case to retire and replace that equipment — and the 700/300 split exactly mirrors the 700 lobby / 300 through-the-wall split in the recycler tender. It also quantifies war damage as a distinct driver: 300 machines are being formally valued as vandalism-damaged. Separately, the desk-based 3-day format means the buyer values structured fleet data it does not currently hold, which is itself a services opening.
verified_signals.likelihood: High — published, bid, and already through qualification on the bank's own platform.
verified_signals.win: Accessibility hint: LOW for this contract itself — bidding has closed and it is a tiny expert-services lot. Its value is as corroboration and timing intelligence for signal 1. NOT a forecast of outcome.
verified_signals.followup: 1) Use the 700/300 mirror as the sizing argument in any approach on the recycler tender. 2) Try to obtain the resulting condition acts or their summary — they would give the first hard read on the age and damage profile of PrivatBank's self-service fleet, which is otherwise undisclosed. 3) Watch for a follow-on disposal, refurbishment or war-damage-compensation procurement, which this assessment is the natural precursor to.

residual_gaps: INCUMBENCY UNRESOLVED — the single biggest gap. The prior recycler programme (stage 1 PB-2023-11-30-3050725, stage 2 PB-2024-05-20-3055047, announced budget EUR 18,678,948.30) shows status 'Завершено' but publishes NO contract: every lot's contracts tab reads 'Договори вiдсутнi', and lots 1 and 2 are marked cancelled with only lot 3 (the 2-year-warranty variant at EUR 37,300/unit ex-VAT) left active. So it cannot be established from the platform whether that EUR 18.68m ever converted, or to whom. Printec incumbency at PrivatBank is therefore NOT confirmed by anything in this pass — the first pass's 'remaining' note listed it as unconfirmed and it stays unconfirmed. BIDDER IDENTITIES ARE MASKED PLATFORM-WIDE ('Інформація про учасників не розкривається'), so the single 2026 DN-maintenance bidder and the 2024 lot-1/lot-3 participants cannot be named from this source; a company-level check (Opendatabot / YouControl / Prozorro cross-reference on EDRPOU 14360570) would be needed. DONOR FUNDING: the first pass labelled all three signals 'donor-funded' and I could not support this from any primary document — but I also could not disprove donor involvement in general, only its absence from these notices and specs. PrivatBank is state-owned and IFI-funded ATM programmes do exist in Ukraine; this needs a separate check against PrivatBank's own IR/annual report and NBU or EBRD disclosures before the label is used or discarded permanently. FLEET AND FOOTPRINT ENTIRELY UNVERIFIED: total ATM/recycler fleet size, the installed Diebold Nixdorf recycler count underpinning the UAH 4.08m maintenance budget, the GRG Banking H68NL population, branch count, Power Banking coverage, core/digital platform, NBU payment-infrastructure statistics and PrivatBank financials — none were reached in this pass, all remain open from the first pass's 'remaining' list. NO BUDGET is disclosed for the live 1,000-unit recycler tender, so its value rests on the bank's own 2024 per-unit benchmark, which I deliberately did not extrapolate into a headline figure. TENDER STATUS AMBIGUITY: PB-2026-03-17-3068329 has sat in 'Прекваліфікація' since 08/04/2026 with no published outcome nearly four months later — whether that reflects an active evaluation, a stall, or an unpublished result is unknown. ACCESS ISSUES LOGGED: tender.privatbank.ua is an AngularJS single-page app; the cited /commercial/tender/<id>/info URLs do NOT deep-link (they render then rewrite to the site root) and WebFetch plus desktop-User-Agent curl both returned only the 'Loading, please wait' shell — every figure here was instead verified via a headless browser plus two platform endpoints recovered by reading the app's own JavaScript: /commercial/ptr/get-ptr.json?ad-id=<id> for tender data and /commercial/file/document?ps-id=<id>&fv-id=<id> for documents. The search API POST /commercial/v2/registry/main/search rejects unauthenticated calls with 'Invalid CSRF Token', so listing had to be driven through the UI search box. No PDF-to-text tool was available locally, so the Ukrainian and English specs were read from their DOCX equivalents (identical amended versions) rather than the PDFs. ADJACENT ITEMS SEEN BUT NOT VERIFIED IN THIS PASS, all on the same platform and all plausibly relevant to Printec: thermal paper for ATMs and self-service terminals PB-2026-06-11-3070263, UAH 8,784,252, published 11/06/2026; ATM and self-service terminal transport/installation/de-installation services PB-2025-11-25-3066433, UAH 24,100,000, completed, published 25/11/2025; cash-counting-desk consumables PB-2026-07-02-3070824, UAH 2,661,798, published 02/07/2026, currently at winner qualification. The transport/install lot in particular is the largest ATM-adjacent services figure found and deserves its own pass.
